description:
Lists every provider in the registry with what it offers.
Every listed provider is AI Ready: its specs give you a structured description to integrate it from (endpoints, fields, errors, gotchas taken from the provider's docs). verified_count says how many of its capabilities were also tested against the provider's API; all_verified is true when all of them were.
When you show this list, present what each provider offers and give the tested capabilities per provider (e.g. "3/4 tested"), not a headline such as "only one provider is fully verified": a capability not tested yet is still documented and usable, it may contain errors. Before integrating one, check its "status" with get_spec and tell the user if it was not tested.

Returns: { providers: Array<{ slug, name, category, channels?, all_verified, verified_count, capabilities, country_code, docs_public, docs_url }> }
name: list_providers
title: List Providers
